reason: 5.18.1 closes the gap 5.18.0 opened: the landing page and /self-host began advertising that every pending approval leads with a plain-English sentence, while the demo sandbox still rendered raw declared_goal text, because demoListActions never ran the enrichment. The demo dispatch now applies describeAction to the pending-approval queue on exactly the same condition as the real route. The demo's pending fixtures were also replaced with real labelled tool calls: they previously carried abstract pseudo-goals ('REVIEW: data alerting') that no agent sends, which the translator correctly declined to read, so turning enrichment on produced 14 consecutive 'I can't tell you' cards - a worse demo than the raw text. Two pool entries stay deliberately unreadable so the demo still shows the translator refusing to guess. No production code path changed; demo fixtures and the demo middleware only. Platform only, no Node/Python SDK surface change.
